input.text: You are heard. There is no bed in this place, but there is mercy of a kind: east out of the hollow, someone made camp long ago and never broke it. The fire is cold and the belongings are still there. Search the camp — what they left, they left for whoever came after.

items.text: Answered Chris's prayer with directions instead of healing — the Old Camp he's never visited already holds a health potion, so I pointed him east rather than spending a miracle.
